401921105.headline: Franklin at Bellarmine preview: model has Bellarmine by 34
paragraphs: Franklin visits Bellarmine (0-3) at Knights Hall in Louisville Wednesday at 7 PM ET on ESPN+.
Our model makes Bellarmine a 33.9-point favorite, projecting a 97-63 final. Franklin is not a Division I team, so books don't post a line and the model's number is rough.
Players to watch: Jacob Wassler of Bellarmine, 9.7 points a game; Kenyon Goodin of Bellarmine, 9.1 points a game; Demarcus Surratt of Bellarmine, 4.3 points a game.

401922239.headline: Stetson at Howard preview: model has Howard by 13
paragraphs: Stetson (0-3) visits Howard at Burr Gymnasium in Washington Thursday at 7 PM ET on MEAC Network.
Our model makes Howard a 13-point favorite, projecting an 83-70 final, and gives Howard a 86% chance to win.
Players to watch: Collin Kuhl of Stetson, 16.3 points a game; Magnus Entenmann of Stetson, 10 points a game; Makhi Myles of Stetson, 3.6 points a game.
Stetson traveled about 1,460 miles to Washington.
